subject: unless it really works?
author: SUFFUR
body:
... i am testing different types of mastic materials and seeing which will give me the best lap times vs without, i have excel, and other spread sheet programs kruntching the data, as i type, and my results will be coming out soon. Caution double sided tape, you should only unstick the side you are going to use against the disk, if you do both, bits of hair, dust and a small screw seem to attach itself, to its sticky surface. Don't ask why at the speed the disk spins, did this screw not bury itself, somewhere into the interior of my 360.

Also during testing, while using the double sided technique, rolling the edge of the disk in sugar, salt, and other granulated house hold products, does cause, some strange pattering sound effects, like interior rain drops, that are dry, to come from inside my 360.

Ps don't try this yourself, as it will mess with your warranty, and  will kill your XBox 360. Yes, the Legal team have phoned and gave me grief to make sure no other idiot does the same thing, as also the risk of fire, and other ways to do yourself bodily harm.

And where did the screw come from, probably my mind.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: |Speed|
author: SUFFUR
body:
No not another spiked drink, on the old XBox, on Eternal City Long, with a jump down the stairs i have got 380 mph, going into the short cut, when i had a chance to see it, because at that speed i have crashed lots of times, being in awe at my speed that i forget to drive. And on, the Xbox 360, the White Mountain broken bridge gap  i have pulled 405 mph, taken out the van, by landing on it, shooting like a 405mph rocket into the bend, scrapped it and over corrected into the on-coming😠. I can get great top speeds, but controling the beast is hard, and keeping it going, i know you can't touch a thing, and i don't most of the time, but it is still hard to stop running out of boost to keep the speed going at 260 mph, (i normally only get a consistant speed of 230 mph at most these days) i even take my finger off the boost, to save it, as i am already going faster than its supposed to give, but it still Frazzels(this weeks snack food, for the Criterion team) out faster than anyone else i race. Oh BurnoutAholic community what am i doing wrong, i have read and watched Ivor's, write up and videos, on drift jumping, (its like  'not'  mentioning the war), and  i still can't become a great racer and booster😢, i might have to buy another copy and see if the code is better, than the one i have got, just so its all perfect, to beat a top 100 lap time?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
